purpose: Replacement ranked emblems, including Unranked. Preserve generated transparency.

prompts.bronze: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production UI rank emblem for RAZED, an original gritty competitive shooter. Create ONE isolated emblem on a genuinely transparent background, square canvas. Front-facing orthographic studio render of a beautifully crafted heavy metal insignia: sharply beveled layered plates, dark gunmetal recesses, restrained realistic brushed-metal wear, precise symmetric geometry, strong bold silhouette and large simple central motif that reads at 64px. Same visual family across Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Master. Clean premium game inventory art, crisp metallic edge highlights from upper left, no floor, no cast shadow outside the object, no glow cloud, no sparks. The complete emblem fills approximately 82% of the square with comfortable transparent margins, perfectly centered. No text, numbers, letters, logos, skulls, guns, military unit insignia or existing franchise designs. Not a flat vector icon, not a generic rounded shield, not a UI screenshot. Original angular clipped-shoulder armor crest with a pointed lower edge and thick sculpted rim. BRONZE TIER: compact copper and dark oxidized bronze armor crest with one bold upward copper chevron occupying the central field, sculpted stepped rim with subtle fine machining, two small clipped shoulder plates integrated into the outline. Confident simple entry-tier silhouette, no wings and no crown. Rich copper surfaces should remain bright enough to read on a near-black UI; rich warm highlights, dark reddish recesses.
